categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai HYP-ARCH Architectural Design Consultant Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: architectural design and building green energy. The architectural design segment covers residential buildings, public buildings including commercial, office, medical, educational, cultural, and urban renewal projects. The building green energy segment focuses on photovoltaic (solar) power station system integration (EPC), photovoltaic power generation, energy storage services, and charging station investment and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) integrated into architectural design projects and develops green building technologies including passive and active energy-saving methods. In the green energy segment, it utilizes photovoltaic technology, energy storage systems, and EPC project management. The company is also developing AI-based design tools, modular photovoltaic-storage integrated devices, flexible monocrystalline photovoltaic panels, and intelligent energy management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include real estate developers, commercial enterprises, public institutions, and industrial clients. The company has long-term partnerships with top 100 domestic real estate companies, notably including Poly Group, which accounts for over 33% of sales. The markets served span residential, commercial, healthcare, education, and urban planning sectors, as well as industrial and commercial energy consumers for its green energy projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly across China, with projects in nearly 30 provinces and over 60 cities. Major regional markets include East China, Central China, South China, North China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast China. It also has minor overseas operations. Headquarters and main offices are located in Shanghai Free Trade Zone.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai HYP-ARCH operates primarily upstream and midstream in the construction and energy supply chains. It provides architectural design services (upstream) and integrates photovoltaic and energy storage systems (midstream), including project development, EPC contracting, and operation of energy assets. It also engages in investment and asset management downstream through power station ownership and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on green, intelligent, and creative solutions aligned with carbon neutrality goals. R&D priorities include AI-assisted design tools, BIM technology, green building materials, photovoltaic building integration (BIPV), energy storage technologies, and multi-energy complementary systems. It pursues a three-step plan emphasizing distributed photovoltaics, commercial energy storage, charging infrastructure, and virtual power plants, aiming to build integrated 'light-storage-direct-flexible' energy systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through architectural design consulting fees, EPC contracting fees for photovoltaic power stations, sales of photovoltaic and energy storage products, and electricity sales from self-developed photovoltaic power stations. The company also earns income from project equity transfers and energy management services, including peak-valley arbitrage in energy storage.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a well-known domestic architectural design and green energy service provider with top-tier qualifications and a strong brand reputation. It competes with other leading architectural firms and renewable energy developers in China. Its integrated approach combining architectural design with green energy solutions positions it uniquely in the market, leveraging its full industry chain capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 138.6 million, a 4.2% decrease from the previous year, with net losses attributable to shareholders of about RMB 113.2 million, reflecting increased losses. The green energy segment grew rapidly with a 94% revenue increase, while architectural design revenue declined. The company has a workforce of 332 employees, including 253 R&D personnel, and maintains significant investments in subsidiaries and projects nationwide.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai HYP-ARCH emphasizes its integrated 'design + technology + operation' service model, combining architectural creativity with advanced green energy solutions to deliver high-quality, sustainable, and low-carbon buildings and energy systems. Its unique value lies in its full industry chain capabilities, innovative R&D in AI and BIM, and customized zero-carbon factory and park solutions, enabling clients to achieve efficient, aesthetic, and environmentally responsible projects.
